build_MFFViT_backbone: build a MFFViT Vision Transformer backbone with multi-level feature fusion for masked image modeling pretraining
build_MFF_model: build a MFF model for pixel-based masked image modeling with reduced wasted modeling capability
run_MFFViT_forward_masked: run the MFFViT forward pass with random patch masking to get hidden features and restore ids
run_MFF_loss_training: run the MFF loss computation during training to get loss components and projection weights
review_MFFViT_proj_layers: review the MFFViT class projection layers and learnable softmax weights for multi-level feature fusion
